question: Should ClickClack expose author-only editing of persisted channel and thread messages in the primary UI?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing capability rather than a repair to an established UI contract, so implementation quality cannot determine whether message editing matches the intended communication and moderation model.

options.title: Sponsor constrained editing
options.body: Approve the author-only, non-pending/non-failed editing scope shown here and proceed with ordinary merge review.

options.title: Retain API-only behavior
options.body: Do not expose editing controls in the UI until maintainers define a broader product policy or audit model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor constrained editing
recommendation.body: Approve the author-only, non-pending/non-failed editing scope shown here and proceed with ordinary merge review.
